title: LLM, RAG and fine-tuning stories vs agents stories on points
question: Does a story about LLM, RAG and fine-tuning get more points than a story about agents?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about LLM, RAG and fine-tuning gets more points than a story about agents.
expect: If true, points per story for LLM, RAG and fine-tuning stories should be at least 1.5x the value for agents stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, LLM, RAG and fine-tuning against agents

group_a.label: LLM, RAG and fine-tuning stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h313 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h313 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
